fe8bfeba-850b-4827-9785-10e2468c9c23.title: Corn
fe8bfeba-850b-4827-9785-10e2468c9c23.description: Wocs love to eat corn. Stacks to 20. Force-place puts the whole stack; Wocs eat the full stack (5 corn = 1 milk).

9a1528a6-acd2-44db-8050-b2f493362191.title: RFS Map Lock
9a1528a6-acd2-44db-8050-b2f493362191.description: Internal map camera lock. Not used — open the atlas with Nutt's GPS tool.

d96c2fe4-177b-49bb-be40-e4b1bcdd8f76.title: GPS
d96c2fe4-177b-49bb-be40-e4b1bcdd8f76.description: GPS. Buy the schematic at the Hideout (1 Farmer), then craft at the Craftbot (1 Metal, 1 Circuit, 1 Component, 1 Glass). In hand: LMB opens the atlas, RMB cycles MiniMap zoom, Q moves/hides the MiniMap, R cycles MiniMap size. Atlas terrain by Nutt.

b4e8c1a0-7d2f-4a91-9c3e-29f1a8d6b5e7.title: Hack Beacon
b4e8c1a0-7d2f-4a91-9c3e-29f1a8d6b5e7.description: Computer for hijacked robots. Connect a Battery container. Press E to hijack hostiles within 16 m (1 Battery each). Keep it powered and in range or they revert to hostile.

c5f9d2b1-8e30-4ba2-ad4f-30a2b9e7c6f8.title: Control Beacon
c5f9d2b1-8e30-4ba2-ad4f-30a2b9e7c6f8.description: Stronger computer for hijacked robots. 32 m range. Connect a Battery container. Press E to hijack (1 Battery each). Keep it powered and in range or they revert.

d6a0e3c2-9f41-4cb3-be50-41b3c0f8d709.title: Infection Beacon
d6a0e3c2-9f41-4cb3-be50-41b3c0f8d709.description: Powerful computer that can permanently infect robots into submission. 48 m. E infects immediately. Tethered bots that stay in its powered field for ~8 s also go permanent.

e7b1f4d3-0a52-4dc4-cf61-52c4d1e9e81a.title: Area Loader
e7b1f4d3-0a52-4dc4-cf61-52c4d1e9e81a.description: Keeps this area streamed (one 64 m cell) while powered. Wire a Battery container; optional logic switch. Light Battery drain. Units may still exist — cell load cannot exclude bots.

f8c2a5e4-1b63-4ed5-9072-63d5e2f0f92b.title: Digital Sign
f8c2a5e4-1b63-4ed5-9072-63d5e2f0f92b.description: Shows custom text on the face. Press E to edit. Optional logic switch: unpowered logic hides the text. No battery required.

09d3b6f5-2c74-4fe6-a183-74e6f3010a3c.title: Digital Sign Large
09d3b6f5-2c74-4fe6-a183-74e6f3010a3c.description: Larger digital sign. Shows custom text. Press E to edit. Optional logic switch hides the text when off.

1ae4c706-3d85-40f7-b294-85f704121b4d.title: Digital Sign Extra Large
1ae4c706-3d85-40f7-b294-85f704121b4d.description: Extra-large digital sign. Shows custom text. Press E to edit. Optional logic switch hides the text when off.

3c06e928-5f97-42a9-d4b6-a7f926343d7f.title: Inventory LCD
3c06e928-5f97-42a9-d4b6-a7f926343d7f.description: Shows one chest stack: item name and amount. Weld onto or next to a chest, or connect LCD → chest. Optional logic switch hides the face. Scrolls stacks. No battery. Not a computer.

4d17fa39-60a8-43ba-e5c7-b80a37454e80.title: Inventory LCD Large
4d17fa39-60a8-43ba-e5c7-b80a37454e80.description: Shows a chest inventory list (item + count). Weld to a chest or connect LCD → chest. Scrolls when there are more stacks than lines. Optional logic switch hides the face.

5e280b4a-71b9-44cb-f6d8-c91b48565f91.title: Inventory LCD Extra Large
5e280b4a-71b9-44cb-f6d8-c91b48565f91.description: Wide chest inventory list (item + count). Weld to a chest or connect LCD → chest. Scrolls extra stacks. Optional logic switch hides the face.

6f391c5b-82d4-4e17-9a60-c1d5e8f2a4b7.title: Chemical Regeneration Station
6f391c5b-82d4-4e17-9a60-c1d5e8f2a4b7.description: Chemical Regeneration Station. Hideout 10 Farmers (schematic). E to stand in the tube. Fill costs 10 Chemicals (~1.5 s purple tank). Heal (~10 s 1→full) drips 10 more Chemicals and 5 batteries (or 1/4 rechargeable cell). Wire a Battery box or Rechargeable box for heal ticks. Mesh: The science fiction Colba by Helley (CC BY), concept CryoCapsules / capitanraketa / Igor Bulygin.

7a402d6c-93e5-4f28-ab71-d2e6f9a3b5c8.title: Solar Panel
7a402d6c-93e5-4f28-ab71-d2e6f9a3b5c8.description: Solar Panel. Hideout 5 Farmers (schematic). Wire electricity to a Rechargeable Battery Box. Charges: sun+clear 100%, sun+cloudy 50%, night 25%, rain+night 5%. About one in-game day to fill one cell. Mesh: Solar Panel by EdwinCGStudio (CC BY).

8b513e7d-a4f6-4039-bc82-e3f70a4b6d9e.title: Rechargeable Battery (Empty)
8b513e7d-a4f6-4039-bc82-e3f70a4b6d9e.description: Empty rechargeable cell (0% charge). Hideout 1 Farmer (schematic). Put in a Rechargeable Battery Box — the box only charges cells already inserted. A full cell equals 20 vanilla batteries.

a0d8469f-c618-425b-de14-06203d7e90c1.title: Rechargeable Battery (Full)
a0d8469f-c618-425b-de14-06203d7e90c1.description: Fully charged rechargeable cell. Equals 20 vanilla batteries. Put in a Rechargeable Battery Box to power devices. Solar recharges empty cells in the box.

9c624f8e-b507-414a-cd93-f4081b5c7eaf.title: Rechargeable Battery Box
9c624f8e-b507-414a-cd93-f4081b5c7eaf.description: Holds 5 Rechargeable Batteries (one per slot, no stacking). Hideout 2 Farmers (schematic). Wire Solar in and devices out (electricity cables, not welds). Each cell = 20 vanilla batteries of energy.
